first.rationale: Prioritize simplifying onboarding because onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ and activation is down 6% QoQ, while prior evidence indicates shorter onboarding durably improved completion, time-to-value, and early self-serve adoption. This directly addresses both deteriorating leading indicators and is better aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than promotional pricing, which previously harmed 30-day retention. Verify the archived onboarding and activation-message records to confirm the original cohorts, effect durability, and implementation details before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. It directly targets the 4% decline in onboarding completion and should improve the linked 6% activation decline: the verified prior experiment increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%. Signup simplification also showed a durable first-week activation lift. This has stronger sustainable-value evidence than promotional pricing, whose acquisition gains came with materially worse retention. Activation messaging remains a credible follow-up, but onboarding simplification addresses the earlier funnel break and has the stronger verified retention result.
